summary: SAML mappings on upgrade: SOCIAL_AUTH_SAML_ORGANIZATION_MAP users true becomes an organization map with a users trigger and role Organization Member, and SOCIAL_AUTH_SAML_USER_FLAGS_BY_ATTR is_superuser_attr/value becomes an is_superuser map with an attributes has_or trigger.
questions: How is SOCIAL_AUTH_SAML_USER_FLAGS_BY_ATTR migrated to AAP 2.6?
How do I make SAML users superusers by attribute in the gateway?
What does a SAML organization map look like in AAP 2.6?
